## Plan / test matrix

Acceptance criteria → behaviours → tests (all new tests live in
`tests/exports/` + `web/tests/unit/`):

| AC | behaviour | test(s) |
|---|---|---|
| crawl: 0 broken links on a fixture release | `validate_release` crawls `release_dir` HTML; link → file or virtual route | `test_validate_release_crawls_links_*` |
| planted broken link fails with page+target | crawler names file + href | `test_validate_release_fails_on_planted_broken_link` |
| staged tree: denied route resolves (410) | `activate` crawls `staged` after `apply_withdrawals`; denied routes allowed | `test_activate_*` staged crawl case |
| chrome on every page type | `_layout` emits nav + dispute link + licence line | parametrised renderer test |
| edge type: configured vs observed distinct; JSON field | `record_claims` `access_kind` + `ClaimAnchor.access_kind` + page column | record_claims + release-page tests |
| dossier: provisional posture, landing link, no "reviewed" | `dossier_page` posture line; `release_landing` dossier links | string tests |
| 0-record landing explains itself | `release_landing` honest-empty block | string test |
| `web/leverage.json` emitted by `run_spine_export` | spine export always writes the metric (recorded feed folded in; else zeroed ledger) | `test_spine_export` leverage cases |
| empty-tile state | `astro.config.mjs` no longer fails on zero listed tiles; map page states the absence | `map-tiles`/`data` unit test + page note |

Implementation notes:

- Root-absolute archive links (`/r/<pub>/…`) replace the depth-fragile
  `../../` forms in `record_page` (evidence) and `_record_li` (browse /
  jurisdiction rows). Correct relative links (`browse/…`, `descriptor.json`)
  stay — the crawl verifies either form.
- `access_kind`: `record_claims` rows carry it for access-vocabulary claims;
  a materialized edge's recorded `access_kind` for its `evidence_claim` wins
  (never re-derived). `exports.shaping._classify_access_kind` delegates to
  `reconcile.materialize.classify_access_kind` (drops the unsafe bare
  `"use" in predicate` substring rule) with the `unclassified` fallback kept.
- `validate_release` stays signature-compatible; `activate` runs the same
  crawl over the assembled `staged/` tree with the withdrawal-denied route
  set allowed (explicit 410).

## Progress

- (seed) branch created, run ledger opened.
- Implemented all seven deliverables; new test module
  `tests/exports/test_release_archive_chrome.py` (31 tests) + web unit tests
  `web/tests/unit/export-tiles.test.ts` (8 tests).
- Choice recorded for deliverable 7 (the ticket's "pick one"): **emit
  `web/leverage.json` from `build_spine_export` always** — a spine export now
  writes the recorded metric, or the zeroed ledger when no changeset feed was
  bound. Chosen over the data.ts "not available" fallback because a
  metric-shaped artifact keeps the surface identical across exports (no
  conditional UI branch to test) and the zeroed ledger is itself an honest
  statement — "0 accepted attributions measured", not a missing file. `data.ts`
  keeps failing LOUD on a missing file (that now means a pre-P34.34a or
  malformed export, which should not silently render).
- Real bug found by the new zero-record test, fixed in the same change:
  `validate_release` read `scope.get("indexed_records") or -1`, which misread
  a legitimate scope of `0` as missing — a 0-record release was *unvalidatable*
  (C4 NEW-31 could never have shipped).
- Public exposure: none — the archive reaches `public` only through P35.63
  (HG-11); this row is engineered/fixture-verified only.

## Self-review (Phase 3)

Mechanical pass:
- `link_crawl_failures` parses `href`/`action` only; same-origin = no scheme,
  no `//` host; fragment/query stripped before resolution; `index.html`
  directory routes resolve; site-shell/overlay routes are an explicit
  enumerated set (`EXTERNAL_LINK_ROUTES`/`EXTERNAL_LINK_PREFIXES`), never a
  wildcard; denied withdrawal routes resolve as the honest 410.
- Chrome is centralised in `_layout` — nav + dispute link are unconditional,
  the licence line renders only when the page shows data (tombstone/error
  pages carry none — an honest `None`, never a fabricated basis).
- `access_kind` is additive/sparse: JSON and page bytes are unchanged for
  non-edge claims (back-compat); the reconciler's recorded kind wins for a
  materialized edge's `evidence_claim` (never re-derived); the predicate
  fallback is gated on the access vocabulary (`sharing`/`access`/`_edge`) so
  e.g. `portal_stated_prohibited_use` is never mislabelled an edge.
- `shaping._classify_access_kind` now delegates to
  `reconcile.materialize.classify_access_kind` — drops the unsafe bare
  `"use" in predicate` substring rule; `unclassified` fallback kept.
- Leverage artifact carries only hashtag/count/changeset-ids — no OSM user
  data (Part VIII §0.7); feed bytes are operator-bound replay (`raw
  ["osm_changeset_feeds"]`, declared `operator_bound_replay`), never a live
  poll (HG-08).
- Empty tiles: `resolveTileCopyList` (new `web/scripts/export-tiles.mjs`)
  returns an empty list for a zero-archive manifest, still fails loud on a
  missing manifest or listed-but-absent archive; `map.astro` renders
  `EMPTY_TILE_STATE_NOTE` only in export mode with zero sources.

Design pass: the crawl is byte-deterministic over the corpus (no HTTP); the
activation-time re-crawl covers the *composed* staged tree post-withdrawals;
digest-check tampering in the planted-link test is repaired so only the crawl
flags.
